LanguageData.SSC_AphrodisiacCenser.label: aphrodisiac censer
LanguageData.SSC_AphrodisiacCenser.description: Heat humpshroom in PNA at the bottom of an ornate censer to produce mist. No electricity or switch; runs while stocked. Radius 5, same room only. Holds 5 humpshrooms, consuming 1 per day. Starts empty. PNA is used only in construction. Existing humpshroom effects fade naturally after exposure ends.
LanguageData.SSC_AphrodisiacAtomizer.label: electric aphrodisiac atomizer
LanguageData.SSC_AphrodisiacAtomizer.description: Improved mixing and precision electric heating turn PNA and humpshroom into mist. Direct player switch; radius 5–10, default 5, same room only. Power: 50 + 2 × radius² W. Humpshrooms: 0.02 × radius² per day; capacity 10. Starts empty. No consumption when off or unpowered; PNA is used only in construction.
